verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Global Accounts with local bank details for receiving bank transfers via local rails and SWIFT. That implies account and routing details exist for the business, but the evidence never explicitly describes viewing them. Nothing in the pack mentions generating a bank verification letter. missing for 10: explicit documentation of viewing account/routing numbers in the dashboard, any bank verification letter generation capability, on-demand/anytime access, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can view account and routing numbers and generate a bank verification letter anytime

citations.quote: Global Accounts enable you to receive bank transfers via local payment methods and/or SWIFT from you, your customers, other parties and various platforms such as Amazon and Google.
Programmatically create accounts with local bank details to collect in 60+ markets for your customers
